tools.name: create_quiz
tools.description: Create geography quiz questions: guess the country from its flag or outline, pick the capital, pick the most populated country, or name a neighbour. Ask the user one question at a time, then pass the user's answer and the question's ticket to check_answer. Do not guess the answer yourself, and do no

tools.name: check_answer
tools.description: Check the user's answer to one create_quiz question. Pass the question's ticket, the user's answer exactly as given (a letter, a name or a code), and the score_ticket from the previous check_answer, if there was one. Returns whether it was correct, the right answer, facts to share in the user's lang

tools.name: random_country
tools.description: Pick a random country, optionally from one continent, with its capital, flag, region, population and languages.

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: Facts about one country: capital, region, population (World Bank 2024), area, languages, currencies, driving side and neighbours. Accepts a name in English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Japanese or Italian, or an ISO code.

tools.name: search_countries
tools.description: List countries by part of a name or capital, by continent, or landlocked only. Returns names, codes and capitals; call get_country for the full facts.

tools.name: compare_population
tools.description: Rank 2 to 4 countries by population, largest first, with World Bank 2024 figures.

tools.name: get_borders
tools.description: The countries that share a land border with a country. An island nation returns an empty list.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_quiz" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Create geography quiz questions: guess the country from its flag or outline, pick the capital, pick the most populated country, or name a neighbour. Ask the use…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "create_quiz" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Create geography quiz questions: guess the country from its flag or outline, pick the capital, pick the most populated country, or name a neighbour. Ask the use…

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_answer · Public sink: check_answer, get_borders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_answer · Public sink: check_answer, get_borders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
